		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = zin_cold_tt_west_ready

					has_global_flag = zin_west_council
					has_global_flag = zin_west_route_divided
					has_global_flag = zin_west_route_crossing
					has_global_flag = zin_west_route_relief

				}
			}
		}
		days_re_enable = 180
		complete_effect = {
			zin_cold_sell_timber = yes

			base = 3
			modifier = {
				add = 200
				zin_cold_date_timber_1 = yes
				check_variable = { zin_cold_timber_sales < 0.99 }
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 200
				zin_cold_date_timber_2 = yes
				check_variable = { zin_cold_timber_sales < 1.99 }
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				zin_cold_historical = yes
				NOT = { zin_cold_date_timber_1 = yes }
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				zin_cold_historical = yes
				NOT = { zin_cold_date_timber_2 = yes }
				check_variable = { zin_cold_timber_sales > 0.99 }

			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				zin_cold_historical = yes
				check_variable = { zin_cold_timber_sales > 1.99 }

			}
		}
